$comment: Default LLM models per provider for each pipeline step. Pick the active provider with `php bin/build.php --provider=<name>` or the LLM_PROVIDER env var (falls back to default_provider below). Every step is tagged with a tier (large | small); the active provider's model for that tier is used. Small = fast/cheap structural steps; large = quality-critical creative/generation steps. OVERRIDES (any model id, always win): LLM_MODEL_<STEP> for one step (e.g. LLM_MODEL_SITE_SPEC=gpt-5.5), LLM_MODEL for the whole run's large tier, LLM_MODEL_SMALL for the small tier.
